annotations.title: Add or remove the code for your order

description: Let our agent buy your plan, on an order you placed (an Audit Drive, a Payment proof or a checkout test): add or replace a discount code, a seat on our account (an upgrade when we ask), or, for a checkout test only, a test-mode login; remove: true deletes it. It's sealed, never shown back (whoami and my_orders show its kind, last two characters and status). On an Audit Drive a code serves every drive until 365 days after the report; otherwise it goes after the drive that used it.

remove.description: true: delete the code or login on this order now

value.description: code: 6 to 64 letters, digits, dots, dashes or underscores; sandbox: the login (up to 2,000 characters)
